{
  "name": "last-look",
  "version": "0.1.3",
  "description": "Holds destructive commands until you approve, and shows what they would destroy.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/last-look",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/last-look#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "safety",
    "bash",
    "rm",
    "git",
    "guard",
    "destructive",
    "review"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "alwaysAllow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Always allow",
      "description": "Comma list of folders that are fine to delete or overwrite without asking (dist, build, node_modules/.cache). A command passes only when every path it touches is inside one of them.",
      "default": "dist,build,.next,coverage,node_modules/.cache"
    }
  }
}
